content: {"rule": "K-S2", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text uses the absence of explicit textual resolution of paternity as the reason for UNDERDETERMINED.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "D6 vs C4 (Romans 1:3): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] section A.1-2 and [CR3] Link 6 premises 1-3, where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.", "rule_words": "That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.", "room": "without explicit textual resolution of paternity -- reading 1: this is lack of an explicit verse statement and cannot ground UNDERDETERMINED; reading 2: this only describes the combined chain as still unresolved on support and is allowed.", "why": "The judge labels the point UNDERDETERMINED because paternity is not explicitly resolved in the text, which is the absence of an explicit verse statement that K-S2 forbids as a ground for UNDERDETERMINED."}
